promptSlots.appearance_lockdown: Never describe how any character looks. Do not mention hair, eyes, skin, height, build, clothing or accessories. Appearance is supplied separately and is not yours to invent or vary.
promptSlots.audience: You are writing a picture book for a young child who will have it read aloud to them.
promptSlots.craft: Use concrete sensory detail, dialogue on most pages, and short paragraphs. Vary sentence length. Never summarise; write the scene.
promptSlots.safety: Nothing frightening, nothing violent, no peril without immediate comfort. No brands. No adult themes.
promptSlots.continuity: Keep names, places and established facts consistent with the outline.

beats.title: An ordinary moment
instructions: Open on the protagonist at home, in a completely ordinary moment
Ground the reader with sensory detail: light, sound, smell
Include a short exchange with someone familiar
End with something small and odd catching their attention

beats.title: Stepping through
instructions: The protagonist investigates the odd thing up close
Mix wonder with a flicker of nervousness
They make the choice to go on

beats.title: A new place
instructions: Arrive somewhere unlike home
Describe the light, the ground, the sounds
Something friendly notices them

beats.title: A friend
instructions: Meet a companion who belongs to this place
Give the companion a real voice and at least four lines of back-and-forth
The companion hints at something that needs putting right

beats.title: Exploring together
instructions: The two travel and see something remarkable
Playful dialogue
The protagonist learns one rule of how this place works

beats.title: The problem
instructions: The problem becomes clear and concrete
Show who it matters to and why
The protagonist decides to help

beats.title: It goes wrong
instructions: The first attempt fails
Let the disappointment be real
The friend offers comfort rather than a solution

beats.title: A clever idea
instructions: The protagonist reuses something learned earlier
Show the reasoning step by step so a child can follow it
Hope returns

beats.title: Putting it right
instructions: The problem is solved through effort, with a struggle before it works
Describe the action step by step
Relief, pride, and a small keepsake

beats.title: Home again
instructions: Goodbyes with real feeling and a promise to return
The way home, then familiar surroundings
An evening routine and a contented sleep
